Visit-only V0. authored_environment_available flips to true only after the Soul-owned L_VikingHarbour_Authored map is authored and verified locally [LRC]. Keep battle_enabled false so the registry loader does not require an arena_origin; siege remains forbidden for non-human_capital settlements by the current loader.
proposed_new_registry_entry_viking_harbo.loader_compatibility_check_VCS: With battle_enabled=false and siege_environment=null, SoulSettlementEnvironmentRegistry.cpp Load() requires no arena_origin and no siege_origin, so this row parses cleanly. visit_environment is not validated for /Game/Soul prefix by the registry loader itself; the /Game/Soul guard is enforced at visit time by CanVisit (SoulSettlementVisitGameMode.cpp:63-65) and VisitSettlement.

proposed_visit_profile_struct_DP.home_recommendation: Add an optional visit_profile object per Environment Registry entry (home A), parsed into a new FSoulSettlementVisitProfile. Entry points are authored-map-space facts and belong beside the map binding.

FSoulSettlementVisitProfile.walkable: bool; default false; false => overview camera only (current Dwarf/Viking behaviour)
FSoulSettlementVisitProfile.entry_probe_points: array of [x,y,z] measured ground candidates in authored-map space; the GameMode line-traces each and spawns on the first physically clear point (ImpactNormal.Z > 0.75)

companion.label: world nameplate text
companion.requires_heartland: bool; keeps Rowan behind the Heartland flag; new factions default false

validation_rules_DP: Every /Game/... string must StartsWith('/Game/') and pass FPackageName existence before LoadObject (mirror SoulSettlementEnvironmentRegistry map validation).
walkable=true requires at least one entry_probe_point and a non-empty avatar.mesh; otherwise reject to overview-only rather than spawn nowhere.
A visit profile is immutable presentation input: it never changes ownership, encounter legality, or save truth.
